dev_orchard_sensor_log.scope: One standard benchmark case; DEV and TEST are never combined. Actual native packet records only, separate from direct-prefill observer measurements and CPU reference codecs. Savings include all measured packet components, calculated outer framing and full decoder state once. An estimate is not a full-cache measurement.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. No packet repacking or online selector exists here; selection compute, mode dispatch latency, encoder work, and attention benefit are not measured. This is not an implemented prefill policy or a latency result.
stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state. Full-cache estimates scale selected inner+mode bytes by total/measured before adding full framing. A mode table/dispatcher implementation is not serialized or benchmarked.

test_pottery_kiln_diary_2048.scope: One standard benchmark case; DEV and TEST are never combined. Actual native packet records only, separate from direct-prefill observer measurements and CPU reference codecs. Savings include all measured packet components, calculated outer framing and full decoder state once. An estimate is not a full-cache measurement.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. No packet repacking or online selector exists here; selection compute, mode dispatch latency, encoder work, and attention benefit are not measured. This is not an implemented prefill policy or a latency result.
stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state. Full-cache estimates scale selected inner+mode bytes by total/measured before adding full framing. A mode table/dispatcher implementation is not serialized or benchmarked.

test_python_dependency_walk_2048.scope: One standard benchmark case; DEV and TEST are never combined. Actual native packet records only, separate from direct-prefill observer measurements and CPU reference codecs. Savings include all measured packet components, calculated outer framing and full decoder state once. An estimate is not a full-cache measurement.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. No packet repacking or online selector exists here; selection compute, mode dispatch latency, encoder work, and attention benefit are not measured. This is not an implemented prefill policy or a latency result.
stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state. Full-cache estimates scale selected inner+mode bytes by total/measured before adding full framing. A mode table/dispatcher implementation is not serialized or benchmarked.

test_museum_loan_register_2048.scope: One standard benchmark case; DEV and TEST are never combined. Actual native packet records only, separate from direct-prefill observer measurements and CPU reference codecs. Savings include all measured packet components, calculated outer framing and full decoder state once. An estimate is not a full-cache measurement.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. No packet repacking or online selector exists here; selection compute, mode dispatch latency, encoder work, and attention benefit are not measured. This is not an implemented prefill policy or a latency result.
stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state. Full-cache estimates scale selected inner+mode bytes by total/measured before adding full framing. A mode table/dispatcher implementation is not serialized or benchmarked.

test_pottery_kiln_diary_8192.scope: One standard benchmark case; DEV and TEST are never combined. Actual native packet records only, separate from direct-prefill observer measurements and CPU reference codecs. Savings include all measured packet components, calculated outer framing and full decoder state once. An estimate is not a full-cache measurement.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. No packet repacking or online selector exists here; selection compute, mode dispatch latency, encoder work, and attention benefit are not measured. This is not an implemented prefill policy or a latency result.
stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state. Full-cache estimates scale selected inner+mode bytes by total/measured before adding full framing. A mode table/dispatcher implementation is not serialized or benchmarked.

test_museum_loan_register_8192.scope: One standard benchmark case; DEV and TEST are never combined. Actual native packet records only, separate from direct-prefill observer measurements and CPU reference codecs. Savings include all measured packet components, calculated outer framing and full decoder state once. An estimate is not a full-cache measurement.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. No packet repacking or online selector exists here; selection compute, mode dispatch latency, encoder work, and attention benefit are not measured. This is not an implemented prefill policy or a latency result.
stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state. Full-cache estimates scale selected inner+mode bytes by total/measured before adding full framing. A mode table/dispatcher implementation is not serialized or benchmarked.
